nav.label: Your account
overview.title: Your account
overview.heading: Your account
overview.intro: Your details, and the messages you get from DripNepal.
overview.verify_body: Until you confirm your email address, you can't place an order or apply for a shop.
profile.heading: Profile
profile.email_help: You sign in with this address. It can't be changed here.
profile.full_name_rule: Enter your name, up to {max} characters.
profile.phone_help_none: A Nepali mobile number, such as 98XXXXXXXX. Checkout asks for one.
profile.phone_help_saved: Your saved number ends in {last4}. Enter a new number to replace it, or leave this empty to keep it.
profile.phone_rule: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 96, 97 or 98.
profile.marketing_email: Email me offers and news from DripNepal
profile.marketing_sms: Text me offers and news from DripNepal
profile.marketing_help: Untick a box to stop those messages at once. Emails about your account and orders still arrive.
security.title: Security
security.heading: Security
security.intro: Your password, the devices signed in to your account, and closing your account.
password.heading: Change your password
password.new_help: Use {min} to {max} characters. A few words you will remember work well.
password.new_rule: Enter a password of {min} to {max} characters.
password.done_body: This device stays signed in. Other devices are signed out, and we've emailed you about the change.
sessions.heading: Signed-in devices
sessions.intro: If you signed in on a shared or lost device, sign it out from here. This device stays signed in.
sessions.action: Sign out of all other devices
sessions.confirm_title: Sign out of all other devices?
sessions.consequence: Every other browser and phone signed in to your account is signed out. This device stays signed in.
sessions.done_body: They need your password to sign in again. We've emailed you a notice.
delete.heading: Delete your account
delete.intro: Deleting closes your account at once: every device is signed out, and you can't sign in again. DripNepal staff then delete your personal details. If you own a shop or have orders in progress, staff deal with those first.
delete.consequence: Your account closes now and you are signed out everywhere. Order and payment records are kept for as long as business records must be kept.
profile.unchanged: There are no changes to save.
